list.name: nears_guest_cart_merge_rejection_rate
list.description: NEARS-2801: guest.cart.merge.rejected counter, token_mismatch/unknown_guest rate over the last 5min. NOTE: stream_name/column names here follow the OTLP metrics ingestion convention documented in dashboards/README.md (metric-name dots -> underscores, flat attribute columns) — verify against the live 'guest_cart_merge_rejected' metrics stream in OpenObserve after the first real rejection and adjust if the ingested shape differs.

condition.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rejections FROM "guest_cart_merge_rejected" WHERE reason IN ('token_mismatch', 'unknown_guest')
